items.summary: Update all user-facing occurrences of the old company name "Legend Techno Solutions" to the new company name "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" across the marketing site UI and shared metadata, including (at minimum) header branding text/aria-label/alt text, footer branding/copyright, logo lightbox alt text, and the HTML document title/meta description where it appears.
Increase the header’s overall size so it appears visibly larger than the current header, while keeping the layout responsive and ensuring the navigation and mobile menu remain usable.

Ensure the company name "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" is prominently shown in the header branding area (next to/near the logo) across breakpoints, including on small screens (do not hide the company name entirely on mobile).

Update the Motoko backend default site content so that a fresh deploy (or empty state) uses "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" in the default SiteContent fields where the old company name appears (e.g., hero heading and about heading/description). Do not change existing stored site content values for already-deployed canisters.
